summary: CA-101 (strict work-unit state machine + DAG): implemented uc/strict_state.py and upgraded uc.cli state-update/state-render. Closed state enum (CA registry 12 states ∪ runbook lifecycle = 15), one-directional LEGAL_TRANSITIONS with only documented rework loops (blocked<->preflight_locked, blocked<->implemented, independent_review->implemented), dependency gate (leaving pending to any non-blocked/non-superseded state requires all deps accepted/already_satisfied), reviewer gate (accepted requires a reviewer distinct from the implementer), per-unit single-writer locks (uc.lock resource unit-<id>, TTL 600s), and DAG cycle detection (dag.cycle_check). CLI refusals demonstrated on the real machine: pending->accepted jump rc=2, accepted without reviewer rc=2, free-text status 'accepted on 2026-08-14' rc=3 — with zero state writes. state-render emits a read-only Markdown view (never a source of truth). 11 new tests including property tests over all 15x15 state pairs (illegal pairs rejected, legal pairs pass) and cycle detection. Full suite: 93 passed. Existing accepted units CA-001~004 are grandfathered (history preserved, no re-validation). Product code/config/CI/catalog/roots: zero writes.
